verdicts.title: p-adic Equiangular Lines and p-adic van Lint-Seidel Relative Bound
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We introduce the notion of p-adic equiangular lines and derive the first fundamental relation between common angle, dimension of the space and the number of lines. More precisely, we show that if $\{τ_j\}_{j=1}^n$ is p-adic $γ$-equiangular lines in $\mathbb{Q}^d_p$, then \begin{align*} (1) \quad\quad \quad \quad |n|^2\leq |d|\max\{|n|, γ^2 \}. \end{align*} We call Inequality (1) as the p-adic van Lint-Seidel relative bound.
